description.p: Sparkle Clean finds files that are safe to remove and shows exactly how much space each kind takes before anything is deleted. You choose what to clean.

ul.li: The APT package cache and packages nothing needs anymore
Old snap revisions and unused Flatpak runtimes
Old system journal entries, rotated logs and crash reports
Stale temporary files that no program has open
The Trash, the thumbnail cache, and web browser, pip and npm caches

description.p: System files are cleaned by a small helper that can only perform a fixed set of tasks and asks for your password through the standard system dialog. Every cleanup is logged, and a command-line interface is included for scripts and remote machines.
Sparkle Clean is now a desktop app.

ul.li: See how much space each category uses before anything is deleted, and pick what to clean
System files are cleaned by a small, restricted helper authorized through polkit
Crash reports and web browser caches can be cleaned too
Every cleanup is logged and kept in a history
A command-line interface for scripts and remote machines
